originalText: 广西布政司人户二十一万八千七百一十二户

sources.note: 万历六年广西布政司人户总数；保留省级登记口径，不拆分为府州。

audit.revisionNote: Recorded directly from the Wanli sixth-year provincial household roster; no interpolation to 1600 and no prefectural allocation.

originalText: 广西布政司人口一百一十八万六千一百七十九口

sources.note: 万历六年广西布政司登记人口总数；不当作完整实际人口估计。

audit.revisionNote: Recorded registered population retained as the source total; not treated as a complete actual-population estimate.

originalText: 广西布政司田土共九万四千二十顷七十四亩八分零

sources.note: 万历六年广西布政司实在田土总额；按顷、亩、分换算为顷，未作现代面积转换。

audit.revisionNote: Recorded directly from the Wanli sixth-year land register; normalized 1顷=100亩 and 1亩=10分.

originalText: 广西布政司夏税麦米二千四百九十四石七斗一合六勺零

sources.note: 万历六年广西布政司夏税麦米主项；丝折米等另列项目不并入本指标。

audit.revisionNote: Recorded as the Wanli sixth-year actual summer-tax 麦米; normalized 1石=10斗=100升=1000合=10000勺 and kept separate from other listed grain items.

originalText: 广西布政司秋粮米三十六万九千二百二石五斗二升六合零

sources.note: 万历六年广西布政司秋粮本色米主项；花利米等另列项目不并入本指标。

audit.revisionNote: Recorded as the Wanli sixth-year actual autumn-grain 本色米; normalized 1石=10斗=100升=1000合=10000勺 and kept separate from separately listed grain items.
